name: Benton Harbor Fruit Market
description: Benton Harbor Fruit Market is a farmers market in 1891 Territorial Road Benton Harbor, MI, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
